name: Katagiri Yuuma
source:
[url=/c6966]Yukino's[/url] childhood friend, with whom he spent his first year of high school in the same class and [url=/c6964]Runa[/url] who just arrived at high school. Like his friends [url=/c61540]Mitsukuni[/url] and [url=/c61700]Kaoru[/url] and many other high school students, he is a great admirer of the pretty president of the student council, [url=/c6962]Makabe Midori[/url] and a huge fan of the actress [url=/c77450]Saeki Rion[/url].

For his second year, Yuuma met [url=/c6963]Kyou[/url] and [url=/c6965]Maya[/url], two of his classmates with whom he gets along quite well. Although not well known in class, he isn’t someone with no presence at all, just a high school junior you can find anywhere. Being nosy and having bad luck are his main traits. Sometimes he regrets his school life.
